data.gender_notes: Goss is used as a unisex name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The meaning of Goss is recorded in name-lists as “God's pledge”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Goss expresses “God's pledge”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Goss total 15, reducing to 6. Number 6 is associated with responsibility, care and harmony.

in_hebrew.name: גוס
in_hebrew.long_meaning: One who is unclear in speech, or who stutters.

in_greek.name: Γοσσός
in_greek.long_meaning: A name of unknown meaning in the Greek Bible, possibly derived from a Greek word meaning 'stammerer' or 'gossiper'. In the New Testament, it is the name of a centurion who asks Jesus to heal his servant (Matthew 8:5-13; Luke 7:1-10).

in_latin.name: Gossus
in_latin.long_meaning: A name of Latin origin, derived from the Latin word 'gossus', which means 'gossip' or 'stammerer'. It is not found in the Latin Vulgate, the official translation of the Bible into Latin.
